attributes.description: Authentication and access overview for Snowflake login history and sessions. ACCOUNT_USAGE data may lag 45 minutes to 3 hours.

params.markdown:
This dashboard covers authentication and access for the Snowflake integration. It summarizes login 
attempts over time, login locations, activity by time of day and day of week, and counters for active sessions and failed logins.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/snowflake/overview)**
